d: Company Description Integrated Clause Company provides consultancy in management systems along with specialized training services, focusing on close collaboration and a clear understanding of customer requirements. The company’s mission is to facilitate clients’ business journeys toward excellence by delivering innovative management system solutions. Its vision is to become one of the market’s leading Omani companies in providing innovative management system solutions and related support services. Integrated Clause Company is guided by core values of accountability, transparency, ethics, and teamwork, creating a professional and client-centered work environment. Team members are encouraged to contribute to continuous improvement and high-quality service delivery.

Role Description The Health Safety Environment Engineer is a full-time, on-site role based in Ibri. This role is responsible for developing, implementing, and maintaining health, safety, and environmental (HSE) management systems for client organizations, ensuring compliance with applicable standards and regulations. Daily activities include conducting risk assessments, workplace inspections, and incident investigations, as well as preparing reports and recommending corrective actions. The engineer collaborates with clients and internal teams to design and improve HSE processes, supports audits, and contributes to continuous improvement initiatives. The role also involves delivering training sessions to client personnel, promoting safety awareness, and supporting the integration of HSE practices into overall management systems.
q: Candidates should possess strong Health & Safety and Environment Health and Safety (EHS) skills, with experience in applying relevant standards and best practices.
Candidates should possess Occupational Health and Safety Engineering skills, including risk assessment, hazard identification, and incident analysis.
Candidates should possess Training skills, with the ability to design and deliver effective HSE training programs for diverse audiences.
Candidates should possess knowledge of management systems (e.g., ISO standards), regulatory compliance, and audit support.
Candidates should possess strong analytical, problem-solving, and report-writing skills, with attention to detail and accuracy.
Candidates should possess effective communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate with clients and multidisciplinary teams.
Relevant bachelor’s degree in engineering, occupational health and safety, environmental science, or a related field; professional certifications in HSE are an advantage.
Previous experience in HSE roles within consultancy, industrial, or construction environments is preferred.
